pairs: his qui sunt in Deo Patre dilectis,
to those who are beloved in God the Father,
and who are guarded and called in Jesus Christ:
and love be fulfilled in you.
omnem sollicitudinem faciens scribendi vobis de communi vestra salute,
taking all care to write to you about your common salvation,
necesse habui scribere vobis: deprecans supercertari semel traditæ sanctis fidei.
I found it necessary to write to you in order to beg you to contend earnestly for the faith that was handed down once to the saints.
Subintroierunt enim quidam homines (qui olim præscripti sunt in hoc judicium) impii,
Dei nostri gratiam transferentes in luxuriam,
who were written of beforehand unto this judgment:
impious persons who are transforming the grace of our God into self-indulgence,
et Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum negantes.
and who are denying both the sole Ruler and our Lord Jesus Christ.
So I want to caution you.
scientes semel omnia, quoniam Jesus populum de terra Ægypti salvans,
Those who once knew everything that Jesus did, in saving the people from the land of Egypt,
secundo eos, qui non crediderunt, perdidit:
afterwards perished because they did not believe.
who did not keep to their first place,
but instead abandoned their own domiciles,
in judicium magni diei, vinculis æternis sub caligine reservavit.
he has reserved with perpetual chains under darkness, unto the great day of judgment.
et finitimæ civitates simili modo exfornicatæ,
having given themselves over to fornication and to the pursuing of other flesh,
suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
these ones certainly defile the flesh,
Cum Michaël Archangelus cum diabolo disputans altercaretur de Moysi corpore,
When Michael the Archangel, disputing with the devil, contended about the body of Moses,
non est ausus judicium inferre blasphemiæ:
he did not dare to bring against him a judgment of blasphemy,
so instead he said: “The Lord commands you.”
But these men certainly blaspheme against whatever they do not understand.
in these things they are corrupted.
For they have gone after the way of Cain,
et errore Balaam mercede effusi sunt,
and they have poured out the error of Balaam for profit,
and they have perished in the sedition of Korah.
Hi sunt in epulis suis maculæ,
These ones are defiled within their banquets,
which are tossed about by winds;
quibus procella tenebrarum servata est in æternum.
for whom the whirlwind of darkness has been reserved forever!
Prophetavit autem et de his septimus ab Adam Enoch, dicens: Ecce venit Dominus in sanctis millibus suis
And about these, Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied, saying: “Behold, the Lord is arriving with thousands of his saints,
et arguere omnes impios de omnibus operibus impietatis eorum,
and to reprove all the impious concerning all the works of their impiety,
by which they have acted impiously,
et de omnibus duris, quæ locuti sunt contra Deum peccatores impii.
and concerning all the harsh things that impious sinners have spoken against God.”
walking according to their own desires.
And their mouth is speaking arrogance,
admiring persons for the sake of gain.
quæ prædicta sunt ab apostolis Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
be mindful of the words which have been foretold by the Apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,
quoniam in novissimo tempore venient illusores,
in the end time, there would arrive mockers,
secundum desideria sua ambulantes in impietatibus.
walking according to their own desires, in impieties.
These are the ones who segregate themselves;
they are animals, not having the Spirit.
Vos autem carissimi superædificantes vosmetipsos sanctissimæ vestræ fidei,
But you, most beloved, are building yourselves up by your most holy faith,
keeping yourselves in the love of God,
exspectantes misericordiam Domini nostri Jesu Christi in vitam æternam.
and anticipating the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
So certainly, reprove them, after they have been judged.
hating even that which is of the flesh,
Ei autem qui potens est vos conservare sine peccato et constituere ante conspectum gloriæ suæ immaculatos in exsultatione in adventu Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
Then, to him who has the power to keep you free from sin and to present you, immaculate, with exultation, before the presence of his glory at the advent of our Lord Jesus Christ,
to the only God, our Savior,
per Jesum Christum Dominum nostrum, gloria et magnificentia,
through Jesus Christ our Lord: to him be glory and magnificence,
imperium et potestas ante omne sæculum,
dominion and power, before all ages,
